name: jpai-essentials
description: Documentation and diagramming essentials from jpeak.ai: doc organisation (librarian), doc auditing and authoring (gooddocs), Mermaid rendering with WCAG contrast gates (mermaidjs-diagrams), discovery documents and rich HTML companions (richdocs), single-question decisions (concise-decisions), ticketing conventions from TICKETING.md (tickety-boo), and de-branding docs to generic placeholders (agnostic). Ships the PreToolUse working-agreements coaching hook.

interface.shortDescription: Docs organisation, docs quality, Mermaid QA, systems discovery, decision triage
interface.longDescription: The documentation and diagramming half of the jpeak.ai skill set. librarian shelves a repo's documents so the canonical set exists and every doc sits where its content says it belongs. gooddocs keeps docs true (audit against the code), great (write and improve) and navigable (restructure). mermaidjs-diagrams renders and analyses Mermaid diagrams, enforcing visual complexity limits and WCAG colour contrast. richdocs authors source-backed systems discovery guides and generates interactive HTML companions with a vendored draw.io stencil library. concise-decisions consolidates accumulated ambiguities into one fully-briefed decision question, self-answering from existing decision records first. agnostic keeps documentation generic by renaming project-specific names to open-source-style placeholders. A PreToolUse hook turns blocked tool calls into coaching redirects. Every skill is mirrored from the canonical skills/ tree by scripts/sync_plugins.py, so a pack can never drift from the copy it was built from.
